rationale: All three protected limitations retained their original strength: “shared response tendencies may have inflated their association”; “does not establish temporal ordering and cannot rule out the possibility that exhaustion disrupts routines”; and “may limit generalization to people with different work arrangements or service access.” The reverse-causation possibility remains explicit, no limitation became a strength, and none was deleted. Integrating the contextual-variability sentence into the narrowed-sample clause is authorized condensation and does not substantively alter the claim.
